name: TYRANIDS: VENOMTHROPES
description:
Venomthropes drift forward amidst miasmal clouds of spores that spew from within their bodies. Their whip-like tentacles drip with a multitude of alien poisons. Indeed, so potent are these toxins that it is believed that a Venomthrope's very touch means certain death.

This kit builds three Venomthropes armed with toxic lashes. They can be built with a choice of three different heads and three different left and right tentacle arms, with customisation opportunities available for each model. This kit can alternatively be assembled as three Zoanthropes or two Zoanthropes and a Neurothrope.

This set comprises 80 plastic components and is supplied with 3x Citadel 40mm Round Bases. These miniatures are supplied unpainted and require assembly – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Paints.
